question: Does the FNaF 3 title model's absent side hold against a real non-title screen, rather than against a black frame?
method: Held the shared lease. ONE tap, on OPTIONS at the measured row (420,975). NEW GAME sits at y=528, 447 px away, and was deliberately never approached because a wrong read there erases the save. Launch, settle 12 s, tap, three frames, KEYCODE_BACK, restore FNaF 2 and verify focus.
findings: Both gates read EXACTLY 0.0000 on a genuine non-title screen, against floors of 0.20 and 0.10. The absent side is measured, not assumed.

A frame 4 s after backing out of Options lands in the model's undecided band and the observer returns ambiguous rather than asserting absence. That is the band working, not a false negative; a caller must not treat one post-transition frame as an answer.

The Options screen exposes Display Mode (FULL), Perspective Effect (ON) and Controller Size (120%). All three plausibly change rendered geometry and Controller Size most obviously scales on-screen controls, so any FNaF 3 control map is valid only for a stated combination of these.
notMeasured: The New Game confirmation dialog negative. FNaF 2's model earned its menu_gate there; reaching it means tapping NEW GAME, which risks the save, so it was not done. Until then this model may gate a read but MUST NOT gate a NEW GAME tap.

frames.note: Game frames are never committed (docs/evidence/README.md publishing boundary). This record is the derived reading; the frames live on the capture machine only.

rung: None. plans/26 states that nothing in it is a claim or a Plan 12 rung.
